summary: Backend regression + feature suite for the Jan-2026 session: choreographer punctuation bug fix, Read Receipts, Quiet Hours, Chat Reactions, plus mention + account-deletion cascade regressions. All 22 pytest cases passed against the public preview URL. The choreographer_key backfill populated 1161/1161 published-with-choreographer dances (request said ~1163 — 1161 is the actual current library count; every eligible row is keyed with 0 missing). Frontend Landscape Chat Split verified by inspection: instructor.tsx line 968 computes isLandscape = win.width > win.height && win.width >= 640, and styles.chatLandscape uses flexDirection: 'row' (line 1317-1320).
critical_code_review_comments: chat_reactions.summarize_for_messages() aggregation uses $max on a boolean-cast — correct semantics but keep in mind the 'mine' arg (viewer_id) MUST be non-empty; a caller passing '' would incorrectly mark every row as own. All current call sites pass instructor.user_id which is guaranteed truthy by require_instructor.

notification_prefs._in_quiet_window() treats start==end as 'always quiet' — a subtle behaviour worth documenting in the settings UI so an admin who accidentally saves start=0 end=0 knows their chat pushes will vanish. Currently exposed by the disabled=True default which softens the risk.

chat_reads.read_state_for_room() pulls every instructor + admin unconditionally; on a large tenant this could grow. Acceptable for the current Yuma studio scale but consider paging if the instructor pool ever crosses ~200.

routes/choreographer_follows.py GET /choreographers uses server-side substring on the display name (correct) but the aggregate groups by choreographer_key — if two display spellings share a key (e.g. 'Rob Fowler' + 'rob fowler') only one wins via $first which is deterministic-but-not-canonical. Not a bug, just a note.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway users prefixed TEST_ registered and deleted within tests. Reaction rows added/toggled off within same test. One temp chat message per fixture with cleanup in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite at tests/test_choreographer_and_chat_features.py covers all Jan-2026 features. Reuse it for regressions. DB check confirms choreographer_key present on 1161 published-with-chor dances (0 missing). Landscape split is frontend-only — chatLandscape style + isLandscape flag are in place at instructor.tsx line 968/1317.
rca_of_issue: The original bug 'choreographers with punctuation missing dances' was caused by read-time normalisation mismatching write-time. Fix stamps choreographer_key at every write (inject_choreographer_key) + boot-time backfill_choreographer_keys(), then GET /choreographers/{name} matches on the persistent indexed key instead of regex. Verified: A.T. Kinson now returns non-zero dance_count and follow flow round-trips via me/follows with dance_count > 0.
